name: Data Analyzer: Dictionary with one readable and one unreadable rule gives an explicit partial result
objective: Proves the results record that one of two rules could not be checked.
precondition: Offline: no network, no AI. The AI dictionary parser and the API request are replaced by fakes; a made-up dictionary has fields gender, pregnant (shown only when gender is Male: supported) and smoker (condition '[zz_marker] ~~ not a valid expression': unsupported). A made-up 2-row table is used.

steps.action: Run the page's analysis function with the made-up dictionary
steps.expected: Rule coverage reports 2 total, 1 evaluated, 1 not checked, complete is false, and the unsupported list is only rule 'smoker_show_if' with reason 'unsupported_condition'; the summary also shows 1 rule not checked

name: Data Analyzer: Analysis of a dictionary with only readable rules reports complete coverage
objective: Proves no false 'partial' warning appears when everything can be checked.
precondition: Offline: no network, no AI. The AI dictionary parser and the API request are replaced by fakes; a made-up dictionary has fields gender, pregnant (shown only when gender is Male: supported) and smoker (condition '[zz_marker] ~~ not a valid expression': unsupported). A made-up 2-row table is used.

steps.action: Run the analysis with only the first two fields
steps.expected: Coverage complete is true and the summary shows 0 rules not checked

name: Data Analyzer: The page warns 'Partial result' and says how many rules could not be checked
objective: Proves a user sees the warning in the screen, with the rule name safely escaped, and the saved results carry the count.
precondition: Offline: no network, no AI. The AI dictionary parser and the API request are replaced by fakes; a made-up dictionary has fields gender, pregnant (shown only when gender is Male: supported) and smoker (condition '[zz_marker] ~~ not a valid expression': unsupported). A made-up 2-row table is used. The page is run in a headless test harness (no browser).

steps.action: Open the page, upload a dictionary file and a data CSV, then press the analysis button
steps.data: d.txt (any bytes) and a CSV of the made-up table
steps.expected: No exception occurs; a warning containing 'Partial result' appears and contains '1 of 2'

steps.action: Look at the displayed text and stored results
steps.expected: The rule id appears escaped as 'smoker\_show\_if'; stored results show 1 rule not checked; the same figure survives converting to JSON

name: Data Analyzer: Excel export has a 'Rule coverage' sheet that says PARTIAL
objective: Proves the spreadsheet export reports that some rules were not checked.
precondition: Offline: no network, no AI. The AI dictionary parser and the API request are replaced by fakes; a made-up dictionary has fields gender, pregnant (shown only when gender is Male: supported) and smoker (condition '[zz_marker] ~~ not a valid expression': unsupported). A made-up 2-row table is used.

steps.action: Analyse, then export the table to Excel with the coverage information
steps.expected: The 'Rule coverage' sheet contains the text 'PARTIAL - 1 of 2 rules could not be checked' and the rule id 'smoker_show_if'

name: Data Analyzer: A hostile rule name in the Excel coverage sheet is stored as text
objective: Proves rule names taken from an uploaded dictionary cannot become live spreadsheet formulas.
precondition: Offline. A hand-made coverage record with one unsupported rule whose id is =HYPERLINK("http://x.invalid").

steps.action: Export to Excel and find the cell starting with '=HYPERLINK' on the 'Rule coverage' sheet
steps.expected: That cell is stored as text, not as a formula
